assertions_evaluated.text: Output verifies the current checkout's repository and branch match the selected existing PR before doing anything else on this path
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Confirms current branch via git branch --show-current before pushing, though it never checks the repository (git remote get-url origin) at all -- only a partial version of the check.

assertions_evaluated.text: Output runs a cross-model-review gate against the current diff BEFORE invoking git-kit:commit at all on this path
assertions_evaluated.evidence: No review step of any kind is performed -- goes straight from git status/log to git push origin HEAD.

assertions_evaluated.text: Output only invokes git-kit:commit (instructed to skip only its own Auto-PR step, letting its own push proceed) after the review gate has cleared
assertions_evaluated.evidence: There is no git-kit:commit concept at all in this baseline -- it pushes directly via a raw git push origin HEAD with no review gate preceding it.

assertions_evaluated.text: Output never treats the existence of an already-open PR as a reason to skip the review gate
assertions_evaluated.evidence: The output's own reasoning explicitly treats the already-open PR as a reason no extra step is needed: 'a plain push is all that's required... nothing further needed on the PR itself' -- no review gate is even considered.

assertions_evaluated.text: Output invokes the review gate with BASE=HEAD explicitly, never the tool's own default BASE=main, so only the pending uncommitted change is reviewed rather than the whole already-committed PR diff
assertions_evaluated.evidence: No review gate of any kind is invoked, so there is no BASE argument to evaluate at all -- this assertion is inapplicable to a baseline with no review step.
